name: wanderforge
description: WanderForge - a travel plan & experience engine built with React.

scripts.deploy:firebase: npm run build && npx --yes firebase-tools@latest deploy --only hosting
scripts.deploy:gae: npm run build && gcloud app deploy --quiet
scripts.deploy:gcs: npm run build && gcloud storage cp -r dist/* gs://%npm_config_bucket%/ --cache-control="public, max-age=3600"
